actionClasses: rupa verify sheet write and delete command
description: Reviews rupa commands that replace or delete local files the caller names: a render with --force, which can replace an existing file of any type, and `rupa verify --out DIR`, which writes and deletes review sheets in a chosen folder. A plain render is not matched, although it replaces an existing .html or .pdf without asking; `rupa --help` and `rupa --version` are read-only.
name: rupa command protection
saferAlternatives: Drop --force and write to a new .html or .pdf path.
Omit --out from rupa verify, or point it at a new, empty folder.
